_comment: Lab budgets for qa/lighthouse.mjs. Categories are Lighthouse scores (0-100, minimum). Metrics are maximums: LCP and TBT in milliseconds, CLS unitless. Mobile uses Lighthouse's default throttled phone profile; desktop uses its desktop preset. Mobile LCP and TBT limits sit at the edge of Google's 'poor' band, desktop LCP and CLS use the 'good' limit, so a failure means a real problem; the report also rates every metric good / needs improvement / poor.
